definitions.answer_rule: recorded (보완 4 §2.1): the protocol's answers (a default value is negative, a categorical answer carries its value, a multi-choice answer all of its values) and, for a categorical or multi-choice evidence, whether the patient's record holds it with any value, its default included; a binary evidence is answered as the protocol answers it. It is the one thing BED's simulator gives beyond the protocol's answers, by reading a recorded default value as positive; the rule is not that simulator
definitions.P2-value: the main policy, run again here on the same patients
definitions.P2-recorded: P2-value under the recorded answer rule, with the likelihood that fits it, counted from the train records of each disease: a categorical evidence is one question over not recorded and each of its values, the default included, and a multi-choice evidence gets a recorded or not recorded outcome beside its options. Prior, smoothing, question choice and stop are those of P2-value
definitions.B-BED: the main B-BED run of baselines.json (BED's stats file, answers from BED's own simulator), run again here on the same patients
definitions.comparisons: each the first policy minus the second on the same patients, `factor` naming what differs between the two: at the stop and after 5, 10, 15, 20 and 30 questions, the difference in tie-aware GTPA@1 with its patient-bootstrap interval and the patients only one of the two gets right in fixed order with exact McNemar; at the stop, also the difference in mean IL with its interval; for the two P2 policies, the same at the stop of each sensitivity threshold
definitions.reproduces: the records of the earlier stages in the same output directory that the P2-value and B-BED runs of this stage were found equal to, the stop summary and every line of the patient-level file (보완 4 §2.4); empty where a limited run found no record over the same rows

P2-recorded - P2-value.factor: the answer rule: whether a categorical or multi-choice evidence is recorded, with the likelihood that fits it

B-BED - P2-recorded.factor: what is left once both get that information: BED's utility, stop, smoothing and candidate restriction, and the one value BED's simulator gives of a multi-choice answer
